about: measure contests of 2025 in Virginia, in the layout of plan/PLAN.md section 3 with the fields data/README.md adds (D3). Built by pipeline/local_medsl.py from pipeline/intake/va_elect.py's cache (the Department of Elections' official results, read before it refused us; MEDSL holds no 2025).

model.name: the model's own forecast, method D3-v1.1
model.note: each year forecast from a fit on earlier years only; no polls are used

nara.name: National Archives, Electoral College Results (the sitting president's party)
nara.licence: US federal public record; no licence printed

klarner.name: Carl Klarner, State Legislative Election Returns, 1967-2022, Harvard Dataverse doi:10.7910/DVN/FJOGJB, v1.0, released 2024-06-12T21:56:14Z (the races route (a) is fitted on)

va_elect.name: Virginia Department of Elections, results of the 2025 November General, 2025-11-04: local offices and questions
va_elect.licence: no licence printed; the Virginia Department of Elections' official election results, public records
va_elect.note: the results site's page of '2025 November General' (https://enr.elections.virginia.gov/results/public/virginia/2025-November-General, rendered in headless Chromium (pipeline/intake/render_page.cjs), not scrolled: its first 50 contests, finished 2026-11-07T18:23:53Z, sha256 52ccac276f924ff98c6dc1a86c4b4996876ffdcd99bf74413db1780f04db0b2f; headed '2025 November General November 4, 2025 OFFICIAL RESULTS Last Updated Monday, December 1, 2025 at 6:15:08 PM') and its 'Media Export' file (https://enr.elections.virginia.gov/cdn/results/virginia/export-2025-November-General.json, finished 2026-11-07T18:24:08Z, sha256 f04f13b12babdb2c7d5639a7d45d6d6a77102cfc139354eb8b9fd2d52e97b1a7, created 2025-12-01T18:16:36Z), read by pipeline/intake/va_elect.py before the Department refused us (2026-11-07 18:27:48 UTC; nothing is requested from it again). Gate within the certifying source, and its Governor equal to D2's data/governor/2025.json (pipeline/local_va.py; data/local/check-va-local.json), proposed: the page headed 'OFFICIAL RESULTS' and linked from the Department's results page, the figures it shows the file's, a shared contest's locality lines adding up to its statewide count and as many as the page prints, a one-locality contest all reporting, and the over-ballot test within each locality. The file gives no party for any local candidate (the Code of Virginia, section 24.2-613 B, prints a party on the ballot for federal, statewide and General Assembly offices only), and marks no winner; the page marks the shared contests' winners

fips.name: locality FIPS codes: the county_name and county_fips columns of MEDSL's 2024 Virginia precinct file, matched by name to the Department's localities
fips.note: each the state's code 51 and the locality's own code in the Department's file [measured: all 133]
